freeRecognition: Clipboard with a plus sign; add a record or medical checklist.

freeRecognition: Magnifying glass with a check; verify a search result or inspect and approve.
reason: Blind recognition identified both search/inspection and verification.

freeRecognition: Clock with an external plus; add time or create a timed event.
reason: Blind recognition identified both the clock and addition action.

freeRecognition: Overlapping squares with a check; approve a copy or select multiple items.
